page.overview:
What is Crescent Lake?

Crescent Lake is a town from the original Final Fantasy located on the southeastern island on the shore of a lake shaped like a crescent. The Circle of Sages is located here, as well as Lukahn.

The Warriors of Light can visit this town using a ship anytime after the canal near Mount Duergar is open. While this not required to progress the story, they can listen to Lukahn and the Circle of Sages' prophecy, as well as their information regarding the Four Fiends and the Crystals.

After the lich is defeated in the Cavern of Earth, one of the sages will give the Warriors of Light a canoe to track down the next Fiend, Marilith of Fire. The Circle of Sages state that the Fiend lies to the west, making her lair in fiery Mount Gulg. The party must sail up to Crescent Lake's feeding river to reach the volcano.

After defeating Marilith, a man who was previously sleeping in town will wake up and explain that he journeyed around the world for 10 years trying to find the levistone. He believes the cave north of the lake may have it, but he cannot leave town since it would cause his wife to be upset with him.
